name: Live quote and payment collaboration tool

mentions.name: Live quote and payment collaboration tool
mentions.description: This tool streamlines closing client deals with a live Notion-style interface where a salesperson and client collaboratively update a quote and communicate through a shared public link. The same link handles approval and payment via cards or bank transfers using the Stripe API, along with invoicing and sales management. It also enables sending clients professional quotes with detailed project breakdowns so they can clearly see the work and pricing.
mentions.problem: The quoting and payment process for closing clients was outdated and created major friction, both at the author's agency and in a family-run wholesale business.
mentions.source_excerpt: So, I built a software tool to eliminate that friction; it’s like a live Notion-style interface where the salesperson and client can update the quote and communicate via a public link. That same link allows for approval and payment—using cards or bank transfers, obviously via the Stripe API—and handles everything related to invoicing and sales.
mentions.author: andrevalleee
